concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single source image for image-to-3D reconstruction of a small contemporary neighborhood grocery store for an Unreal Engine retail simulation. Create a beautiful, believable architectural visualization, restrained realistic game art, one coherent scene, landscape 16:9. Human eye-height camera in the back-left half of a modest approximately 8m wide by 10m deep grocery, looking diagonally toward the entire front facade and entrance. The front wall is almost entirely clear floor-to-ceiling storefront glazing with slender dark metal frames, a wide genuinely open glazed entrance, level accessible threshold onto a visible sidewalk, and a small slice of an ordinary pleasant contemporary neighborhood street with adjacent building facades visible outside. Generous natural daylight, airy inviting space, realistic restrained materials, light warm terrazzo flooring, off-white plaster, simple ceiling with unobtrusive linear lighting, warm pale wood accents at the shopfront. Clearly a small neighborhood market, not a luxury boutique or giant supermarket. Two low freestanding gondola shelves with modest neatly arranged generic groceries, a compact checkout near the entrance, a small produce stand, refrigeration along a side wall. Keep aisles wide, clear and floor strongly visible; low shelves permit long view to the street. Building geometry legible and coherent: straight verticals, moderate wide angle 24-28mm, no fisheye, ceiling joins and corners visible, avoid heavily occluded architecture. Equipment must look like discrete removable objects, not merged with shell. No people, no cars obscuring the storefront, no readable lettering or brand logos, no decorative clutter, no sepia nostalgia, no medieval features, no cutaway, no dollhouse, no diagram, no UI, no watermark. This should communicate an attractive street-connected neighborhood market with an actual glazed facade, NOT an opaque four-wall box, NOT an outdoor roofless shop. Polished natural daylight with gentle shadows, balanced exposure inside and outside, tactile surfaces, believable everyday retail.
cleanPlate: Preserve exact camera, architecture, glass frontage, open entrance, street and daylight. Remove all shelving, products, checkout, refrigerators and loose decoration; reconstruct unobstructed floor and plain off-white wall. Same shop/view, empty architectural clean plate.
